drhp.business: We are a retail jewellery business engaged in selling a range of diamond jewellery made using natural diamonds and precious and semi-precious gemstones, set in precious metals such as gold, Platinum and silver. Our jewellery is marketed and sold under our brand name “Omara” and is primarily offered through our retail boutique. Our product portfolio comprises a range of diamond jewellery products, including necklaces, earrings, rings, bracelets and other jewellery products, catering to varied customer preferences, age groups and occasions.
drhp.one_liner: We offer jewellery suitable for weddings, festivals, special occasions and daily wear, across various age groups, genders and price ranges.
risks: We are dependent on our suppliers for uninterrupted supply of Raw-Materials.

Any shortfall in the supply of our raw materials, or an increase in our raw material costs and other input costs, may adversely affect the pricing and supply of our products with subsequently having an adverse effect on the business, results of operations and financial conditions of our company.

Any disruption in supply, delay in delivery, quality inconsistency or significant increase in procurement costs may affect our ability to maintain adequate inventory, introduce new designs, meet customer demand and manage pricing effectively.
Any adverse movement in such prices may increase our input costs and working capital requirements.
Further, we procure a significant portion of our materials from certain suppliers based on quality, reliability and commercial terms.

Any inability of such suppliers to meet our requirements, or any disruption in our relationship with them, may require us to identify alternate sources, which may not be available immediately or on comparable terms.
This may result in higher procurement costs, delay in product availability, impact on margins and disruption in our business operations.

overview.business_model: We are a retail jewellery business engaged in selling a range of diamond jewellery made using natural diamonds and precious and semi-precious gemstones, set in precious metals such as gold, Platinum and silver. Our jewellery is marketed and sold under our brand name “Omara” and is primarily offered through our retail boutique. Our product portfolio comprises a range of diamond jewellery products, including necklaces, earrings, rings, bracelets and other jewellery products, catering to varied customer preferences, age groups and occasions.
overview.one_liner: We offer jewellery suitable for weddings, festivals, special occasions and daily wear, across various age groups, genders and price ranges.

internal_operational.risk: We are dependent on our suppliers for uninterrupted supply of Raw-Materials.

Any shortfall in the supply of our raw materials, or an increase in our raw material costs and other input costs, may adversely affect the pricing and supply of our products with subsequently having an adverse effect on the business, results of operations and financial conditions of our company.

Any disruption in supply, delay in delivery, quality inconsistency or significant increase in procurement costs may affect our ability to maintain adequate inventory, introduce new designs, meet customer demand and manage pricing effectively.
Any adverse movement in such prices may increase our input costs and working capital requirements.
Further, we procure a significant portion of our materials from certain suppliers based on quality, reliability and commercial terms.

Any inability of such suppliers to meet our requirements, or any disruption in our relationship with them, may require us to identify alternate sources, which may not be available immediately or on comparable terms.
